patch.objective: Data sources for an investigation: log data (firewall logs, application logs, endpoint logs, OS-specific security logs, IPS/IDS logs, network logs, metadata) and other data sources (vulnerability scans, automated reports, dashboards, packet captures)

sources.cite: CompTIA Security+ (V7), exam SY0-701: domains General security concepts 12%, Threats, vulnerabilities, and mitigations 22%, Security architecture 18%, Security operations 28%, Security program management and oversight 20%
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-16 for this Security+ band. The page lists the five domains and weights above, says English SY0-701 retires on June 11, 2027, and describes the topics: resilience and recovery (high availability, site considerations, testing, power, platform diversity, backups, continuity of operations); third-party risk (vendor assessment, selection, agreements, monitoring, questionnaires, rules of engagement); network attacks among the malicious activities; alerting and monitoring. The objectives PDF was not re-read; the objective wording is the course seed's.

sources.cite: NIST SP 800-61 Rev. 3, Incident Response Recommendations and Considerations for Cybersecurity Risk Management: A CSF 2.0 Community Profile (April 2025)
sources.note: Final, April 3, 2025; supersedes Rev. 2 (2012). The CSRC page was read 2026-11-14 through a summarizing fetch (title, date, status, abstract). The RS.MA, RS.MI, RS.AN and RS.CO outcome text used here was read in the PDF on 2026-11-11 for REQ-238 (docs/sims.md 22.11) and not re-read.

sources.cite: U.S. SEC press release 2023-139, cybersecurity risk management and incident disclosure rules (Form 8-K Item 1.05)
sources.note: Read 2026-11-14 through a summarizing fetch. Relevant text: registrants disclose 'any cybersecurity incident they determine to be material' on Item 1.05; the filing is 'generally ... due four business days after a registrant determines' materiality. Cited only to show why counsel needs facts early; the fictional credit union is not a registrant and the sim sets no legal deadline.
